key_points: Large ETFs sold $310 million of GS stock on Nov 3, indicating short‑term bearish pressure.
Multiple small institutional purchases (e.g., Bank Julius Baer, AIA Group, Associated Banc) suggest modest confidence.
Goldman launched new leveraged and autocallable note products, expanding fee‑based revenue streams.
Analyst raised price target for AMD while maintaining Buy, reflecting positive outlook on related growth themes.
GS and Apollo began marketing a $40 billion SpaceX chip financing deal, a potential new high‑margin revenue source.
